query:
UPDATE series SET
               name = COALESCE($2, name),
               description = CASE
                   WHEN $3::TEXT IS NULL THEN description
                   WHEN $3 = '' THEN NULL
                   ELSE $3
               END,
               pinned = COALESCE($4, pinned),
               sort_order = COALESCE($5, sort_order),
               updated_at = now()
           WHERE id = $1
